aboutCards.title: My Programming Journey
aboutCards.body: I started with HTML & CSS, then fell in love with JavaScript - turning static pages into living interfaces. React taught me component thinking, Next.js taught me full-stack thinking, Node & MongoDB taught me to model real data. AI as a pair-programmer help me a lot.

aboutCards.title: Work I Enjoy Most
aboutCards.body: Responsive dashboard, thinking real-life used digital product, seamless git workflows. I love taking a simple idea → scoped MVP → deployed URL with docs.

aboutCards.title: Hobbies, Interests & Goals
aboutCards.body: I love to do writings, walking alone in solitude, getting drenched in the rain and traveling. My interests are to guiding junior to learn code & Programming. My actual goal is build a system to help people who needs daily life digital solutions.

processSteps.title: Scope with AI, decide like an engineer
processSteps.body: I draft user stories, data models and page maps with AI, then prune ruthlessly into an MVP checklist. AI helps me spot missing edge cases (empty states, auth gaps, mobile layouts) before I write code.
processSteps.prompt: “Break this shop idea into MVP vs v2, with DB schema”

processSteps.title: Generate drafts, craft the final
processSteps.body: AI scaffolds boilerplate and alternative implementations; I choose, refactor and type strictly. Every AI suggestion gets reviewed for accessibility, naming and bundle cost — I never paste blindly.
processSteps.prompt: “3 ways to model cart state — tradeoffs?”

processSteps.title: Narrow, reproduce, fix at the root
processSteps.body: I paste real errors + minimal repros, ask AI for hypotheses ranked by likelihood, then verify with logs and devtools. Fixes include regression notes so the same bug can't return quietly.

processSteps.title: Checklists today, automation tomorrow
processSteps.body: AI generates manual test matrices (devices, roles, edge inputs) and starter Vitest/Playwright cases. I run Lighthouse + keyboard-only passes on every featured build.

projects.title: BazarDor - Price Comparison Platform
projects.description: BazarDor combines product & market price comparison, and user account management in a single web application.
longDescription: BazarDor is a Bangla-focused product price comparison platform designed to help users explore product prices, understand market trends, and make more informed purchasing decisions. The platform provides a convenient way to browse products, examine available price ranges, and identify products whose prices are increasing or decreasing, making it easier for users to stay informed about changing market conditions. BazarDor features dedicated sections for rising and falling prices, allowing users to discover price movements and compare product information more efficiently. Its product sorting functionality enhances the browsing experience by helping users organize listings and find relevant products with greater ease. By bringing product information and price trends together in one platform, BazarDor aims to make market price exploration more accessible and user-friendly for Bangla-speaking consumers. The platform also includes a secure, user-friendly authentication system powered by Better Auth, supporting email and password authentication as well as Google and GitHub sign-in options. Registered users can access their accounts, view their profile information, and update their personal details through the profile management features. Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, BazarDor uses a modern web development architecture to deliver a responsive and maintainable user experience. Better Auth integrates with MongoDB for authentication data storage, while React Icons provides interface icons, React Toastify handles toast notifications, and react-marquee-text supports scrolling text elements within the interface. Overall, BazarDor combines product price comparison, market price movement tracking, intuitive product browsing, and user account management in a single web application. Its goal is to help users better understand product pricing and navigate market information with greater convenience and confidence.

projects.title: DevStack - Technology Stack Builder
projects.description: DevStack is a simple and interactive web app. It helps explore different technologies and build ideal development stack.
longDescription: DevStack is a simple and interactive web application that helps developers explore different technologies and build their ideal development stack. Users can view details such as difficulty and rating, and add their preferred technologies to their stack. They can also remove individual technologies or clear the entire stack. The application provides categories such as frontend, backend, database, and development tools, allowing users to compare available options and create a personalized technology stack.
